AI Website Builders

10Web

10Web uses AI to generate, recreate and edit WordPress websites while bundling managed hosting and AI-assisted site management.

What is 10Web?

10Web is an AI website-building platform built around WordPress. It can generate a site from prompts, recreate an existing site's design in WordPress, help users edit pages through an AI-assisted visual workflow and host the resulting WordPress installation, making it especially relevant to users who want AI speed without leaving the WordPress ecosystem.

Best for: WordPress users, agencies and small businesses that want AI-generated sites with managed hosting and familiar WordPress extensibility.

Main features

  • Prompt-based WordPress website generation
  • AI website recreation and redesign
  • AI co-pilot for editing
  • Drag-and-drop page editing
  • Managed WordPress hosting
  • Responsive and SEO-oriented site generation

Use cases

  • Generate a new WordPress business site
  • Recreate an existing website in WordPress
  • Prototype landing pages quickly
  • Host and manage WordPress sites
  • Use AI to revise page structure and content

Who is it for?

  • WordPress users
  • small businesses
  • web agencies
  • freelancers
  • marketers

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription

Starting price: USD 10 / month, with the cited entry price tied to annual billing

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Produces sites on WordPress rather than a closed proprietary CMS
  • Combines AI generation, editing and managed hosting
  • Offers a documented REST API for platform automation

Limitations

  • The product is centered on WordPress, which may be unnecessary for users wanting a simpler closed builder
  • Free access is limited and full editing is tied to the trial/paid workflow
  • Hosting, visitor, storage and AI allowances vary by plan

Frequently asked questions

Does 10Web have a free way to try the AI builder?

Yes. 10Web documents free website generation and a one-week free trial for full editing features; its free access is more limited than a paid subscription.

Is the generated site actually WordPress?

Yes. 10Web's AI Website Builder is designed around WordPress and combines generation with managed WordPress hosting and editing.

Does 10Web provide an API?

Yes. 10Web publishes REST API documentation covering website, DNS, domain, SSL, backup and related platform operations.
